claims.summary: En ciertas sílabas sin inicial, y y w funcionan como recursos separadores y no como iniciales consonánticas.

sourceLinks.sourceTitle: 现在小学拼音教学中还要强调整体认读音节么?

sections: 答復：y、w 與零聲母音節

sourceLinks.notes: La respuesta del Ministerio indica que y/w no son 声母, sino que funcionan para separar sílabas en ese contexto.

claims.summary: La tabla oficial registra y + ao → yao y w + an → wan.

semanticReview.method: Manual comparison with official Chinese MOE response and Taiwan MOE Hanyu Pinyin syllable chart

findings.supports: The Ministry says y/w are not initials and serve to separate syllables in relevant zero-initial forms.
The syllable table includes y + ao → yao and w + an → wan examples.

limitations: Removed generalizations about exact vowel transformations and pronunciation; only the cited role and table examples remain.
